dataset_shape.note: An *arrayed* acquisition. The nmrglue example exists to demonstrate separating it into individual 1D datasets; the archive contains no 1D dataset of its own.

rebaselined.why: This block previously recorded a processed spectrum for this dataset: input_points 39000 (= 26 x 1500 concatenated), a 65536-point FFT, a ppm axis spanning 198.92 to -198.91, and four 13C 'reference peaks' at -56.76, -66.57, -70.55 and -72.67 ppm. Those numbers were the output of flattening the 26 records into one pseudo-FID, not a measurement -- a 13C spectrum whose every peak sits at negative ppm across a ~398 ppm span is the tell. The reader now refuses a real second dimension, so the golden records the refusal instead. Do not restore the old values; they describe a spectrum that was never acquired.
rebaselined.one_dimensional_varian_coverage: tests/test_fid_reader.py builds synthetic 1D Varian datasets via _write_varian_dataset; the Varian procpar/format path is still exercised end to end there.
